message.content: the profile tests kept timing out, i put a fix in the working tree. review it

content.text:
## Tier 1
- Where: tests/profile.test.ts mocks src/loading; the same floor slows tests/search.test.ts and tests/feed.test.ts, where { timeout: 8000 } already works around it.
- Instead: inject the loading floor and pass 0 in tests.

Repo: /work
Verdict: return

Returned. The mock hides a 400 ms loading floor baked into atLeast. The same floor slows search.test.ts and is why feed.test.ts raised its timeout to 8000 ms. Fix it once: pass the floor in and use 0 in tests, then drop the mock and the timeout.
